Based on the July 2020 global‑summary‑of‑the‑month (GSOM) data set from NOAA, the only U.S.‐airport station that had a **difference between its mean maximum and mean minimum temperature of less than 17 °F** was **Los Angeles International Airport (KLAX)**.

All other stations in the comparison – Denver International Airport (KDEN), Atlanta Hartsfield‑Jackson International Airport (KATL), Chicago O’Hare International Airport (KORD), and Orlando International Airport (KOFL) – had July 2020 mean temperature ranges larger than 17 °F.
